title: Sleep on lid close and via global shortcut do not work anymore
line: Closing the lid, pressing the power button or the Sleep key now puts the computer to sleep even when the chosen sleep mode (sleep then hibernate, hybrid sleep) isn't available.
explanation: When the sleep mode is "Standby, then hibernate" or "Hybrid sleep" but the system can't do that mode (logind reports it as unavailable, e.g. hibernation disabled), powerdevil's SuspendSession action still asked for it, and libkworkspace silently ignores a mode logind says is unavailable. So lid close, the power button and the Sleep shortcut did nothing, while the app menu and KRunner worked because they use plain suspend. The KCM hides the option in that case, but the old value stays in powerdevilrc. The change makes SuspendSession use suspend-then-hibernate or hybrid sleep only when the suspend controller says it can, and plain sleep otherwise.

commits.message:
suspendsession: Use plain sleep if the sleep mode is unavailable

With "Standby, then hibernate" or "Hybrid sleep" set but not available,
for example after hibernation was disabled, the lid, power button and
Sleep key did nothing at all. Use plain sleep in that case instead.

BUG: 498298
BUG: 500841

media.caption: Master, sleep mode set to sleep-then-hibernate (top) and hybrid sleep (bottom), logind mock says neither is available: Sleep key, power button and lid close reach logind with no sleep call at all.
With the fix, same steps: each one sends a plain Suspend to logind.
